d: Amazon is seeking a dynamic and customer-obsessed Supervisors to lead and develop teams within our fast-paced AMZL (Amazon Logistics) and FC (Fulfilment Enter) environments. This role will encompass responsibilities across both areas, requiring a versatile leader who can thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing operational landscape. You will play a crucial role in ensuring efficient workflows, exceeding customer expectations, and driving continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to make history with one of the world's largest and most innovative companies, shaping the future of operations and logistics.

Operational Leadership: Oversee daily operations within both AMZL and FC environments, including managing teams of Operations Supervisors, Operations Assistants, Delivery Service Providers, and associates (ranging from approximately 30-40). This includes allocating labor, leading meetings, assigning job duties, and maintaining exceptional organizational skills.

Team Management: Lead, train, and develop high-performing teams. Foster a positive and motivating work environment, driving engagement and performance while ensuring associate safety and adherence to Amazon's Health and Safety standards.

Performance Management: Be obsessed with metrics, diving deep to identify root causes of performance issues, and implementing effective solutions. Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and drive improvements across both AMZL and FC processes.

Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline and improve processes. Find practical and simple solutions to complex problems without compromising quality or functionality. Utilize problem-solving and analytical skills to drive Dive Deep analyses and implement process enhancements. Become a subject matter expert on core operational processes.

Communication & Collaboration: Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions. Effectively communicate with business and technical audiences, influencing decisions and driving alignment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges and share best practices. Manage external agency relationships and performance.
Problem Solving & Decision Making: Demonstrate strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Act decisively in a fast-paced environment, exercising sound judgment and making informed decisions.

Technology & Tools: Continuously utilize software and hardware tools to ensure smooth daily operations. Ensure associates have the necessary tools and coordinate repairs or replacements as needed. Support the rollout and implementation of new systems and processes, gathering feedback and providing support.
Inventory Management: Maintain inventory accuracy within the FC environment.
q: Experience with planning, performance metrics, and process improvement

d: You have extensive experience in luxury retail management, with a strong track record in driving business performance, developing teams and implementing successful retail strategies.

You are a strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen, excellent leadership skills and the ability to navigate complex business environments. You naturally build strong relationships with stakeholders and inspire teams to achieve excellence.

Analytical, proactive and results-oriented, you combine a client-centric mindset with a genuine passion for luxury retail. Your ability to drive change, foster collaboration and develop talent will be key to succeeding in this role.
What are we expecting from you?
As Market Retail Director, you will define and implement the retail strategy across the Market, in alignment with the Maison’s vision and business objectives.

Working closely with the Managing Director, Regional and International teams, you will drive business performance, ensure operational excellence and lead the development of retail teams while delivering an exceptional client experience.
r: Defining and implementing the Market retail strategy to drive sales, profitability and sustainable business growth.
Monitoring business performance through key retail KPIs, identifying opportunities and implementing action plans to enhance boutique performance.
Leading, coaching and developing Boutique Managers and retail teams, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Partnering with HR to anticipate talent needs, support recruitment, succession planning and team development across the retail network.
Overseeing boutique operations and ensuring compliance with Maison standards, policies and operational procedures.
Collaborating with Retail Operations, Marketing, Client Experience, Finance and other cross-functional teams to support business priorities and commercial initiatives.
Driving the implementation of regional and international retail initiatives, ensuring alignment with local market needs and business objectives.
Identifying business opportunities, monitoring market trends and competition, and providing strategic insights to Regional and International teams.
Leading boutique development projects, including new openings, network optimization and the maintenance of high retail standards.
Defining and implementing High Jewelry client development strategies, supporting VIP client relationships and identifying opportunities to strengthen the Maison’s client portfolio.
Supporting the development of High Jewelry expertise within retail teams through coaching, training and talent identification.
Acting as an ambassador of the Maison, nurturing relationships with key clients and partners while supporting exclusive client events and commercial opportunities.
More than a role… We recruit for a career!
By joining Van Cleef & Arpels, you will become part of a Maison where excellence, creativity and people development are at the heart of everything we do.

From your first day, you will be supported through comprehensive onboarding and continuous learning opportunities designed to help you grow your expertise and build a long-term career within the Maison and the Richemont Group.

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application, and should your profile match our requirements, you will be invited to meet with the recruiter. You will then have the opportunity to meet with the Hiring Manager and relevant business stakeholders throughout the recruitment journey.
